❓ New here? How to use this page
Every Patek Philippe offer in the chats over the last 14 days — HK and US, HKD/USD/USDT all normalized to USD.

How a deal makes the podium — an offer only counts as a deal against its own cohort: the same reference in the same condition (a used 2014 watch never benchmarks a sealed 2026 one), needing ≥3 quotes. The AI stack then applies the same triple check as the US Market page: a robust z-score anomaly scan throws out fat-fingered prices, an HK ⇄ US cross-check catches currency mix-ups, and a backtest (early vs late window + eBay agreement) confirms the price is stable.
Metals matter: /1A steel, /1R rose gold, /1G white gold — a 5990/1A and 5990/1R are different watches with very different prices, so they are tracked separately.
Click a model row to see every message, cheapest first.
